headline: Granted tax abatement requests for Unitil and Public Service Co. of NH properties.
summary: The meeting covered hardship requests, late exemption requests, a warrant, abatement requests, and other items. Abatement requests 25-006 from Unitil and 25-016 from Public Service Co. of NH were granted. The minutes do not record outcomes for the other items.
decisions: Approved abatement request 25-006 for Unitil at various properties, marked granted.
Approved abatement request 25-016 for Public Service Co of NH at various properties, marked granted.
